raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line chart illustrating the number of issued decisions for the construction of new settlements from 2012 to 2022, based on data from the National Statistical Institute (НСИ). The horizontal axis (x-axis) represents the years from 2012 to 2022, marked at one-year intervals, with the labels "2012 г." through "2022 г." The vertical axis (y-axis) represents the number of decisions, with a numerical scale ranging from 70 to 187, marked at intervals of 10. The chart displays three data series, each represented by a distinct line: "Административни" (Administrative) is shown as a blue line with no markers; "Други" (Others) is shown as an orange line with circular markers; and "Жилищни" (Housing) is shown as a gray line with circular markers. The "Административни" line remains relatively flat, starting at 170 in 2012 and ending at 70 in 2022. The "Други" line starts at 4,938 in 2012, peaks at 5,562 in 2017, and ends at 4,631 in 2022. The "Жилищни" line starts at 4,238 in 2012, peaks at 5,980 in 2019, and ends at 8,169 in 2022.
